description.shortText: Solar-powered streetlights equipped with CO2 scrubbers that help absorb pollutants present in the atmosphere. While generating light, this solution can mitigate fossil fuel contamination effortlessly.

attachments.name: Eco Mushroom is a solar streetlight that can absorb vehicle pollution
attachments.description: Roads are a highly polluted areas, with polluted air rising up and spreading across an area to create a blanket of toxic atmosphere – not to mention the impact on climate change. The ‘Eco Mushroom’ is a compact design for a solar powered street light equipped with CO2 scrubber to help remove some of this pollution. This artificial mushroom houses four directional LED street lights and an Air Purification System (APS). Four intakes suck in polluted air and pass it through the APS, positioned centrally within the structure. The purified air is finally released through the annular vent on the air duct built around the light pole. A network of Eco Mushrooms integrated into the existing roads could help curb automotive pollution effectively while allowing for smart integration that can send information to a central hub about pollution trends and maintenance needs

attachments.name: Eco Mushroom : Solar Street Light with Pollution Absorber
attachments.description: The roads are a highly polluted zone and cause serious health hazards. The polluted air rises up and spread across to create a blanket of toxic atmosphere. Pollution absorber systems can do some good work. The ideal candidate for placing such a system is the street light; due to its location and height.

attachments.name: Eco Mushroom streetlight absorbs vehicle pollution
attachments.description: An innovative streetlight could be an answer to extreme air pollution caused by CO2 emissions on the road.
